text:
harper mills: Quick heads-up I'm refreshing the 'starter' quickstart to match SDK v8 auth helpers and to add a tiny container deploy hint. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3981. When I ran the example locally I got a 401.

noor ali: likely the env var rename. Which files still reference the old REDWOOD_TOKEN?

harper mills: README bash block and Dockerfile ARG. Also the JS snippet uses oldClient().

zia chen: Swap to createClientFromEnv() and show a 1-line bash export. Keep examples compact so they fit the quickstart skim.

harper mills: Plan: replace REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY, update helper call, add Node + Python tiny snippets, restore Dockerfile ARG example, and add a short admonition about not baking secrets into images.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #3981  lint, linkcheck, mdspell.

ci-bot: linkcheck: warning: docs/quickstart/starter.md line 34 -> https://old-auth.example (redirect).

noor ali: Update the link to /docs/auth to avoid redirect and add a one-liner pointer for enterprise KMS: /enterprise/kms.

harper mills: Added snippets and an env block:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<YOUR_KEY>
# optional: export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=projects/...
```
Node snippet:
```js
import { createClientFromEnv } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = createClientFromEnv();
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1', prompt: 'hey' });
console.log(r.text);
```
Python snippet:
```py
from redwood_inference import create_client_from_env
client = create_client_from_env()
print(client.generate(model='redwood-v1', prompt='hey').text)
```

zia chen: Add the Docker ARG example and a note: "Do not bake keys into images; prefer runtime injection or secret stores." Link to /docs/security/secrets. Keep the quickstart < 200 words.

harper mills: Done, pushed, assigned @noor and @zia as reviewers, and added a TODO to open a CI smoke test issue for building quickstarts (no real keys).

docs-bot: All checks passed for PR #3981. Ready for review.

noor ali: Quick pass LGTM. Minor wording nit inline.

harper mills: Addressed nit and squashed.

docs-bot: PR #3981 merged by noor ali  site deploy queued.

ci-bot: deploy: staging build started 2026-05-12T10:30:00Z

harper mills: Verified staging render; snippets and Docker note present. Will watch prod. Thanks all.

zia chen: Nice small win for onboarding. Closing thread.
